fields.Distinctive evidence: Observed: sparse black-on-white typography and converging line geometry carry from the hero into a numbered product accordion and ATLAS section.
fields.Why it matters and strongest judgment: Interpretation: strongest restrained institutional design in this sample so far; extensive scroll pinning adds friction. Origin, catalyst and reason for attention Unknown.
fields.Project, audience, and token role: Interoperability and finance infrastructure for issuers/developers; ZRO is launched, while the official token article distinguishes future Zero network economics from present products.
fields.Attention and buyer conversion: Geometric motion, recognizable company marks and developer/documentation routes are prominent; social links present. Homepage purchase path not prominent; conversion outcome Unknown.
fields.Participation and return value: Public docs, GitHub and explorer links support a developer build-and-monitor loop without buying merely to browse. Runtime integration not tested.
fields.Trust and free choice: Whitepaper, docs and code links are investigation routes. Console and ATLAS explicitly say launching later this year; logos and broad global-finance copy are claims, not verification.
fields.Unknowns and untested behavior: Products, token value mechanisms, affiliation claims, mobile and reduced motion not tested.
fields.Counterevidence or what would change the: Some hero-level ambitions exceed what is established here; scroll-pinned sections complicate static reading and could weaken usability.
fields.Borrowable principle, not protected expr: Use precise typography and a single family of geometric diagrams to make a complex product suite coherent.
fields.Avoid or no material avoid finding: Avoid copying its line geometry, company logos or language implying institutional adoption the new project lacks.
fields.Useful idea or no useful idea from this: Original idea: a white PONS developer-tools site with three clearly staged offerings and a diagram linking each to its user workflow.
